anchorBay.name: Anchor Bay
anchorBay.onGuardedMessage:
{Anchor Bay}

You sail your ship to this small island, where you can see a large number of pirates gathered. You know this is a major stronghold for local pirates—a place from which they prey upon passing merchant vessels. Eliminating them would not only bring peace to these waters but also yield a great deal of treasure. Do you choose to launch an attack?

onVisited.message:
{Anchor Bay}

You sail your ship to this small island; although it looks like a pirate stronghold, there isn’t a single pirate to be found. You moor your vessel and climb up to a high platform to take in the surroundings—the scenery is truly magnificent.

rewards.message: After the last pirate has been eliminated, you climb the tower and discover a great deal of treasure in their storeroom.
